Proves AR-6's `contains` operator on a `string` field, reusing SEM-7's own worked example (`contains: "art"` against `"Smart Watch"`, which contains the literal substring "art"). SEM-7 pins substring semantics for OpenSearch/Elasticsearch specifically: this MUST compile to a `wildcard` query against the `.keyword` sub-field, never a tokenized `match` query (which would miss this exact case, since "art" is not a whole token of "Smart Watch"). SEM-1 additionally makes the match case-insensitive by default.
